Some insurance plans may also partially contribute toward the PhysioTherapy part of the pelvic floor therapy treatments, so it’s worth asking what your coverage includes (it may vary depending on your provider).

My haul? Purely based off someone else’s find 👀  From what I’ve learned, these items go super cheap when they’re discontinued and supposed to be pulled… but sometimes they get missed and still scan low 👀
There are people who track this DAILY—checking barcodes, sharing in groups… I am not one of them 😂  so here are some FAQ below 
✅️How do I know it’s a penny item? I usually base it off someone else’s haul. That’s honestly how most people start.
✅️And how do they know? From what I’ve seen, people track what gets pulled, share finds in groups, and build lists together… and some people think there might even be leaked internal lists—but I can’t confirm that 😅
✅️What do I say to the cashier? I just stay honest. I explain I believe it’s a clearance or penny item, and if they’re unsure, they can check with a manager. I mention there are penny Dollar tree shoppers across Canada and Dollar Trees have been allowing them to buy it ONCE the customer gets it.
✅️ What if they don't sell penny items?
I would just respectfully ask for a manager to be called and if they don't know, I would ask them to call whoever is above them. However, I would never push a penny find, at the end of the day I still think it 's manager's discretion.

At the end of the day, I’m not the extreme penny shopper I just share what I find when I find it  and specifically I saw @bordercitycouponer 🤷‍♀️
